_comment: Where each gang leader holds court, and what he says.
TWO LISTS, AND ONLY ONE OF THEM IS READ.
"leaders" is who is standing out there. "later" is who is not, and nothing loads it -- it
is a parking bay rather than a disabled flag, so there is no half-live man in the code
waiting to be switched on by something nobody remembers writing.
Everything about a parked man is intact: his corner, his heading, his models and every
line he says. Putting him back is moving his object out of "later" and into "leaders",
and reloading. No rebuild, no compiler, nothing to re-type.
Gerald is the only leader at the moment, and Tao at the docks is the only other person
selling weight (dealers.json, same arrangement). The other eight sets still exist, still
hold turf, still tag walls and still fight -- they just have nobody on the corner to walk
up to yet.
gang      id from gangs.json
zone      GET_NAME_OF_ZONE code, used for the fallback spot and for his blip
x, y      exactly where he stands. Ground height is probed at runtime, so there is no z
to get wrong. Leave both at 0 and he falls back to the nearest pavement to the
zone centre, which is how he ended up standing in the middle of the road.
heading   which way he faces, degrees
awayFromHour / awayToHour   hours he is not on the corner at all, 0-24. Wraps midnight.
Leave both at 0 and he is there around the clock.
models    tried in order; the first one the install actually has is used
greeting / accept / refuse / already   what he says. A man with no greeting cannot be
talked to at all, and the log says so at load rather than letting you drive
across the city to find out.
The spots below are placed by eye and are worth checking in game -- he should be off the
road, in a yard or against a wall, somewhere a man would actually stand.

leaders.name: Gerald
leaders._sprite: 514 radar_drugs, the bag. His third and picked by looking at the art rather than the name, which is how every blip in this pair is chosen now.
leaders._sprite2: It was 51 radar_crim_drugs -- the mark the map puts on a dealer, honest about the trade and useless for finding HIM, because the mod already draws that one wherever there is product. Then 946 radar_four20, which is the leaf, and the leaf is now Lamar's: see Fixer.cs. Two men one street apart wearing the same mark is the thing a per-leader sprite exists to prevent.

later.name: OG Reese
later._spot: Never walked. He stood at the middle of Rancho, which is a road. Give him a real corner before putting him back in "leaders".
later.greeting: Hold up. Who your people? 'Cause I know everybody out here, and I don't know you.
later.accept: Purple look alright on you. Don't get comfortable in it. Somebody gon' be watchin' how you move for a while, and it ain't gon' be me -- you won't know which one he is. That's the job.
later.refuse: I been out here since before you could walk. You think you the first one come up to me askin'? Go get a name.
later.already: I know who you are. Go on.

later.name: El Tio
later.greeting: Ey. You looking for something, or you lost? Around here those are different problems.
later.accept: Bueno. Understand me -- this is not a job. This is a debt. Everything in that bag moves on my name, and my name is not free. You break it, I take it back out of you.
later.refuse: You want me to put my name on a stranger. No. Bring me somebody who will say your name out loud, and then we can owe each other something.

later.name: Chavo
later.greeting: You standing in the wrong place to be asking questions.
later.accept: You're in. Nobody claps. You start where everybody starts, which is carrying what you're given and not asking what's in it.
later.refuse: No. Nobody has said your name to me.
later.already: You're one of ours. What else.

later.name: Bull
later.greeting: You ain't wearing a patch, so make it quick.
later.accept: You're a hangaround. Not a prospect, not a member -- a hangaround. Hangarounds fetch. Fetch long enough and somebody might put your name up at church. Might.
later.refuse: Hangarounds earn it. You ain't hung around. There's a difference and you'll learn it standing over there.
later.already: You ride with us already. So go ride.

later.name: Uncle Wei
later.accept: You may carry for us. Understand what that is, and what it is not. There are men who have worked thirty years and are still outside this family. You are not inside it. You are useful. That is a different word.
later.refuse: You have done nothing, and I have no interest in what you intend to do. Go.
later.already: You work for us already. Do so.

later.name: Sarkis
later.greeting: You want something. Everybody wants something.
later.accept: Fine. You carry, I pay, and we find out what you are worth. Be careful what you show me first -- whatever I decide you are worth today is what you will be worth to me for as long as I know you.
later.refuse: You are nobody, and nobody is worth nothing. Change that and we will talk about numbers.
later.already: You are already mine. What do you want?

later.name: Chuy
later.greeting: This is Banning. Nobody comes to Banning by accident. So which is it?
later.accept: Alright. You're not from here, so listen -- you don't say our name anywhere off this block, you don't bring nobody back here with you, and you never come looking for me at my house. Do that and there's always something to carry.
later.refuse: Your face isn't from here. Neither is your family. Round here that's the same as not existing. Go and exist somewhere else first.
later.already: You're with us. So stop standing out in the open like a tourist.

later.name: Mr Kim
later.greeting: Yes? Be quick. I am polite, not patient.
later.accept: Very well. Two rules, and they are the same rule twice. Nothing loud. Nothing that ends up on somebody's phone. What you sell is your business. What people remember about it is mine.
later.refuse: No. There is nothing written next to your name yet, and I do not do business with a blank page.
later.already: We have an arrangement. Do not spend it standing here.
